documentation.text:
@title Zero Knowledge Proof Credential Escrow
 @notice Trustless fair  exchange for issuer signed digital credentials
 My Design principle : person A never sends anything to B after payment..
 and that is where trust is playing a role. this gross will do No-Trust Barter
 She publishes the El Gamal ciphertext of the key UP FRONT & proves
 in zero knowledge that [1] Firstly it decrypts to a key matching her public
 commitment &[2ndly] that key carries a valid signature from a trusted
 issuer. B only releases funds once the on chain proof check passes
 and decryption happens entirely off chain on his side with his own
 private key. dispute period needed? idk yet but oracal isn't + reaveal as well (no)
 
 reminder to implement niche idea of Non Intractive zero knowledge proof later
 
 contract ==> boilerplate & inits ==> an unchangable id to verify.

just before and after making a position and def funks
 @notice Alice opens a trade by publishing her commitment + ciphertext
         BEFORE any funds move this is the piece that makes the
         exchange atomic: Bob can verify off chain that the public
         data looks right before ever depositing a cent.

i need to drop this non-intractive ZPiK wala thought.  both should
 come online to settle this deal BEFORE deadline or it reverts to..
 @notice Bob deposits the agreed price into escrow. Funds are now
         locked and can only leave via a valid ZK proof (to Alice)
         or a timeout (back to Bob) never by either party alone

@notice Alice settles the trade by submitting their Groth16 proof
         On success, funds move to Alice atomically in the same
         transaction that verifies she holds a genuine actual 
         issuer signed credential matching the already published cipher's text

@notice If Alice never produces a valid proof before the deadline
         Bob reclaims his funds. This is what makes the protocol
         safe for Bob to fund first: worst case is a timeout, not
         a loss
         Still there's a very very small chance that bob's verification
         may be false..   is there anythong stronger than .zk  
         in next version i will use rsi/ris whatever
